reviews.text:
SCAM. I paid $7.99 for the weekly subscription, which already felt expensive, but then I realized you still have to buy coins just to use the app. A single picture costs about 400 coins and a video costs around 600 coins. If the result comes out wrong, you’re expected to spend another 200 coins just to ‘fix’ it and it doesn’t even fix it.

Then I checked my purchase history and it’s even worse. The $7.99 subscription actually charged me $8.64, and the $3.99 coin purchase became $4.31 with extra fees. I ended up paying $4.31 for ONE picture and another $4.31 for ONE video and the picture didn’t even look like me.

So not only are you paying a weekly subscription, you’re also paying per project, plus hidden extra fees on top of that. That’s honestly ridiculous and feels like a complete scam. Deleted the app + unsubscribed the same day.
